evidence_observations.observation: GET https://link.amazon/B04G1MEwY ended at https://www.amazon.com/dp/B0CDY277D3?lv=shuf&btn_type=ss&gaOptInStatus=true&btn_ref=srctok-...&channelId=704&plpRedirect=mhFallback (page title observed: CHEFMAN 6 Quart Dual Basket Air Fryer Oven ...)
evidence_observations.interpretation: Destination of the supplied link: one live CHEFMAN 6 Qt Dual Basket listing. Stable across re-fetches; not bound to the code by any public Amazon document (F-03, F-20).

evidence_observations.observation: GET https://link.amazon/B02NbDxp3 ended at https://www.amazon.com/dp/B09B7SB46R?...plpRedirect=mhFallback (page title observed: Emeril Lagasse 26QT French Door Multi-Function Air Fryer Toaster Oven ...)
evidence_observations.interpretation: Destination of the supplied link: one live Emeril Lagasse 26QT French Door listing (same ASIN on every re-fetch).

evidence_observations.observation: GET https://link.amazon/B00hJ57DV ended at https://www.amazon.com/dp/B08DKYBTPH?...plpRedirect=mhFallback (page title observed: Chefman Air Fryer 8 Qt | TurboFry 4-in-1 ...)
evidence_observations.interpretation: Destination of the supplied link: one live Chefman 8 Qt TurboFry listing (same ASIN on every re-fetch).

evidence_observations.observation: https://www.amazon.com/dp/B04G1MEwY , https://www.amazon.com/dp/B02NbDxp3 and https://www.amazon.com/dp/B00hJ57DV each returned Amazon's "Sorry! We couldn't find that page" error page on 2026-11-13 and again on 2026-11-14.
evidence_observations.interpretation: No catalog record exists for any of the three tokens as given.

evidence_observations.observation: Each token was measured against the ASIN identifier definition (10 characters): B04G1MEwY=9, B02NbDxp3=9, B00hJ57DV=9. Each is alphanumeric, so only the length fails.
evidence_observations.interpretation: Pattern is consistent with a one-character truncation, but the missing character is not recoverable and was NOT guessed.

evidence_observations.observation: CONTROL — an unknown code on the same short-link service: GET https://link.amazon/B00TEST12 (9 characters, never supplied) resolved to https://amzlinks.in/B00TEST12 and returned the service's 404 page — "404: File Not Found … You've clicked on an invalid URL." (image host: amzlinks.in/post-tap/short-link-404.png).
evidence_observations.interpretation: DECISIVE. The service looks the code up: an unknown code returns a 404 instead of an arbitrary product. The three supplied codes therefore ARE honoured lookups, and the earlier reading that the token was ignored and the destination arbitrary (flag F-03) is falsified. What is still unconfirmed is the *contract* — Amazon publishes no document binding a link.amazon code to a product — not the behaviour.

evidence_observations.observation: CONTROL — a bare, untagged GET https://www.amazon.com/dp/B08DKYBTPH (a valid 10-character ASIN) returned the CHEFMAN 8 Qt product page with ?lv=shuf&channelId=500&plpRedirect=mhFallback&th=1 appended to Amazon's own internal links, and with no btn_ref parameter at all.
evidence_observations.interpretation: plpRedirect=mhFallback is emitted on ordinary, direct, valid product-page loads. It is therefore NOT evidence of a fallback and cannot distinguish a valid ASIN from an invalid token.

evidence_observations.observation: The three supplied links each carry their own btn_ref=srctok-… source token and the same channelId=704: B04G1MEwY → srctok-1f979f303a4b5691, B02NbDxp3 → srctok-0cd8be3c7e2e0de3, B00hJ57DV → srctok-7c59360cbbbd59b7 (observed 2026-11-14 ~10:05 UTC).
evidence_observations.interpretation: Three distinct per-link source tokens — the signature of individually tracked links, not of a shared fallback.

evidence_observations.observation: Cross-time check on one link: link.amazon/B04G1MEwY carried btn_ref=srctok-1e229870efde5acf earlier on 2026-11-14 (recorded by session c6e94e8d) and btn_ref=srctok-1f979f303a4b5691 at ~10:04 UTC on the same day, while the destination stayed /dp/B0CDY277D3 on every fetch.
evidence_observations.interpretation: The btn_ref source token rotates over time; the DESTINATION does not. Two earlier claims are therefore both wrong in different ways: 'a different btn_ref on re-fetch proves the destination shuffles' (F-05, F-12) and 'an identical btn_ref proves the token is permanent' (revalidation C-2). See flag F-21.

evidence_observations.observation: None of the three resolved URLs carries a tag= parameter. Each ends …&channelId=704&plpRedirect=mhFallback (short-link arrival) or …?lv=shuf&channelId=500&plpRedirect=mhFallback&th=1 (direct arrival).
evidence_observations.interpretation: The links as supplied are untagged, so they cannot attribute a sale to an Associates account. Amazon's own help page gives the qualifying Special Link format as http://www.amazon.com/dp/ASIN/ref=nosim?tag=YOURASSOCIATEID. See flag F-24.

reverification_note: Session 4338f55e re-read the three supplied links and the three manufacturer pages on 2026-11-14; session a133aa61 re-read them independently with live outbound access on the same day. Both record the same three destinations. The unknown-code control (S32) shows the short-link service honours the code; the per-link btn_ref token rotates between days (F-21).
